title: Request a proof of divorce order
summary: This page provides information on how to obtain proof of a divorce order depending on when the divorce was granted and where it was granted.
who_can_apply: The divorce was granted after 13 February 2010.
The divorce was granted before 13 February 2010.
The divorce order is for someone else.
The divorce was granted in Western Australia.
The divorce was granted outside Australia.
what_you_need: No specific items are listed, but the process depends on the date and location of the divorce.
For divorces before 1976, contact the Supreme Court in the state or territory where the divorce was granted.
For divorces in Western Australia, contact the Family Court of Western Australia.

more_info.text: For information about applying for a divorce, serving a divorce, the divorce hearing and invalid marriages, visit the Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia website – Divorce.

external_links.text: Federal Circuit and Family Court of Australia website – Divorce

faqs.q: How do I get a proof of divorce order for a divorce granted after 13 February 2010?
faqs.a: You can order the proof online, and this service is free.

faqs.q: Is there a fee to order a proof of divorce order for a divorce granted before 13 February 2010?
faqs.a: Yes, there is a fee for this service.

faqs.q: What if my divorce order was granted outside of Australia?
faqs.a: Contact the relevant court or authority in the country where the divorce was granted. For more information about legalising documents in Australia or overseas, visit the Smartraveller website.
